summary: Disambiguate local numeric selectors from GitHub issue IDs

delivery.outcome: Prevent a selected numeric local ticket ID from reading or updating an unrelated GitHub issue; reject conflicting local remote mappings before provider I/O.
nonGoals: No provider credential, lease policy, runtime promotion or whole-operation deadline changes.

architecture.decision: Resolve local selectors before remote aliases; preserve explicit remote references and non-GitHub compatibility, fail closed on conflicting selected mappings.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of the correction without changing authoritative ticket data.

validation.evidence: Numeric local selector collision regression must fail on PR312 and pass after correction, preserving unrelated snapshots and explicit remote selections.
